newsitem.title: USA: American Water Works unit wins Indiana pact.
newsitem.headline: American Water Works unit wins Indiana pact.

text.p: AmericanAnglian Environmental Technologies and Environmental Management Corp said Tuesday their EA2/Systems joint venture won a contract to operate the municipal water system of Evansville, Indiana.
The value of the contract was not announced.

AmericanAnglian, a joint venture between American Water Works Co Inc and Anglian Water Plc, said the 10-year contract is expected to save 200,000 Evansville residents millions of dollars over the next decade.
American Water Works shares were unchanged Tuesday at 23-3/4.
